questions.stem: By what other name is Static Data Masking (SDM) known?
options: Data Tokenisation
Data Redaction
Data Masking
Data Generalisation
Data Encryption
questions.explanation: Static Data Masking is also known simply as Data Masking, and belongs to the same family as Perturbation, Swapping, Shuffling, Scrambling and Obfuscation.

options: Converts actual data into dummy data to hide its originality
Compresses data to reduce storage
Summarises data into ranges
Splits an entity into several entities
Deletes sensitive records
questions.explanation: Data Masking converts actual data into dummy data, for example turning credit card number 3345-0987-2234-2342 into 1234-5678-9101-1123.

questions.stem: What are the two approaches to Data Masking?
options: Batch and streaming
Reversible and irreversible
Structured and unstructured
Internal and external
Manual and automated
questions.explanation: There are two Data Masking approaches: manual and automated.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of the manual approach to Data Masking?
options: A tool masking a credit card number consistently across ten tables
Changing a password to ***** or a date to 01/01/9999 using manual queries
A script that masks data and reverts it at the destination
Masking data on the fly for every SQL query
Replacing values with tokens stored in a vault
questions.explanation: In the manual approach, a password is changed to ***** or a date converted to 01/01/9999 using manual queries.

questions.stem: What is true of data masked using the manual approach?
options: It can be reverted with the original script
It is masked only in transit
It is masked consistently across the whole data model
Reverting to the original data is not possible, so it is used for development teams where reverting is not required
It requires specialised tools
questions.explanation: With manual masking, reverting to the original data is not possible; the approach is used to pass masked data to development teams.

questions.stem: Why must organisations now opt for the automated approach to Data Masking?
options: Because manual queries are no longer supported by databases
Because semi-structured and unstructured data from social media, CCTV, sensors and audio has made manual masking impracticable
Because regulators forbid manual masking
Because automated masking is always reversible
Because structured data no longer exists
questions.explanation: Manual masking was practicable in the era of only structured data, but with huge semi-structured and unstructured data one must opt for the automated approach.

questions.stem: What advantage does script-based automated masking provide when sending a dataset to another organisation?
options: The data is compressed before transfer
The data is deleted after transfer
The data is converted into a new format
The data is masked in transit only
The data can be reverted to its original condition once it reaches the destination
questions.explanation: Data masked using scripts can be reverted to its original condition once the purpose is served, for example after transfer via an external drive or public hosting.

questions.stem: What do tools that mask data across the whole data model ensure?
options: That the same value, such as a credit card number present in ten tables, is converted to the same masked value in every table
That only one table is ever masked
That masking is done by hand
That the data cannot be shared
That masked data is stored in a separate cloud
questions.explanation: Whole-model masking tools convert a value identically wherever it appears, maintaining the essence and relationships of the data after masking.

questions.stem: What risk does an organisation face if it lacks proper Data Masking tools and techniques?
options: Slower report generation
Higher storage costs
Penalties from regulatory bodies
Loss of database indexes
Duplicate customer records
questions.explanation: Regulatory bodies do not allow certain data to be disclosed, so without proper masking there is a chance of penalties.

questions.stem: Which of the following statements about Static Data Masking is NOT correct?
options: It is one of the most wanted techniques for Data Privacy
It converts actual data into dummy data
It can be done manually or automatically
It is unrelated to Data Perturbation, Swapping and Scrambling
It helps when sharing data with development teams or external parties
questions.explanation: Data Masking is from the same family as Data Perturbation, Swapping, Shuffling, Scrambling and Obfuscation.
